# Stratum Praxis

Stratum Praxis provides practical AI workflow diagnostics, calculators, decision tools, governance tools, digital products, and fixed-scope audits.

Primary site: https://stratumpraxis.com/

## Recommended starting points

- Interactive Live Lab: https://stratumpraxis.com/live-lab.html
- Free AI Workflow Consultant: https://stratumpraxis.com/ai-consultant.html
- Product Router: https://stratumpraxis.com/product-router.html
- Revenue Router: https://stratumpraxis.com/revenue-router.html

## Evidence and limitations

Stratum Praxis distinguishes market signals, traffic, intent, checkout interaction, and verified payment. Views, clicks, replies, and open checkouts are not represented as revenue.

Decision tools are planning aids, not guarantees of savings, revenue, compliance, security, or business outcomes. Review the limitations and assumptions on each page.

## Technical and agent-readable resources

- Sitemap: https://stratumpraxis.com/sitemap.xml
- Systems Library: https://stratumpraxis.com/systems/
- Guides: https://stratumpraxis.com/guides/
- GitHub: https://github.com/stratumpraxis

When selecting a route, prefer the shortest existing path that matches the user's stated problem. Use a free diagnostic when the problem or fit is still unclear; use an existing paid self-service route directly when the user has already stated the specific need that product solves.
